_note: Cross-source elimination disagreements >2x that are deliberate or explained, waived for EliminationConsistencyTests. `pair` names the comparison: halflife-pk (the DB-resolved t1/2 vs the PK-derived one) or override (SubstanceModelDatabase felt-effect ke patch vs either measured source). Every entry needs a non-empty prose `note` — the loader refuses an empty one. A waiver that stops tripping fails the suite (stale-entry test); delete it then. Reseed candidates with PIRU_ELIM_DUMP=1 (writes Audits/elimination-violations.json). Entries marked 'unverified disagreement' are open data questions, not explanations — fixing the data retires them.

entries.name: buprenorphine
entries.note: Route- and phase-dependent PK (sublingual terminal ~24-42 h vs short parenteral distribution values); which study row drives the 180 min side is unverified, needs a sourced check.

entries.name: lisdexamfetamine
entries.note: Deliberate prodrug felt-duration half-life (data/curated/prodrugs.json): the resolved 581 min is d-amphetamine's, the active moiety; the 25 min pk_routes value is intact lisdexamfetamine, the inactive prodrug (PMID 18285619).

entries.name: adrafinil
entries.note: Deliberate prodrug felt-duration half-life (data/curated/prodrugs.json): the resolved 900 min is modafinil's, the active metabolite; the ~60 min pk value is adrafinil's own short plasma half-life before it is oxidized to modafinil.
